annotation-toolbar:
Annotation


Use Pencil (✏️) and Eraser (🧹) to draw freehand strokes, Eraser (magic or normal mode) to remove drawings, Rectangle and Circle to draw shapes with customizable stroke/fill, Arrow to add directional indicators, and Text to add labels with font options. Each tool has modifiers for colors, sizes, and styles.
screenshots-toolbar:
Screenshots

Capture screenshots of the canvas. Choose format (PNG or JPG), select target (Clipboard or Download), then click Capture to take a screenshot. Use Snag-it mode to drag and capture a specific area of the screen.
bookmarks-toolbar:
Bookmarks

Manage your bookmarked nodes. Add, remove, and navigate to bookmarked techniques. Bookmarks are automatically saved and scrolled to the selected node.
datasets-toolbar:
Datasets

The Datasets toolbar allows you to browse and select decision flows. Use filters to narrow down results by ownership context (System, Personal, Tenant, Team, Team Group). Click on a dataset to load it into the viewer.
default-team-groups-toolbar:
Default Teamgroups

Default Team Groups allows you to manage predefined team group configurations. Create, edit, and apply default groups to teams. System-level groups are read-only, while organizational groups can be customized.
selection-tools-toolbar:
Selection

Selection tools and modes: Pan (🤚), Select (👆), Lasso (🎯), or Related Nodes (🌳).
explorer-toolbar:
Explorer

Explore nodes in the tree structure. Mark nodes as completed or needing review. Add nodes to favorites or bookmarks for quick access. System dataset nodes can be added to categorized favorites (Movements, Match Skills, Technique).
import-export-toolbar: Import and export team roster data using CSV files. Download a blank template to see the required format, or use the test file with sample data. Import CSV files to quickly add multiple team members with their positions, jersey numbers, contact information, and demographics. Select a team before importing roster data.
lesson-runner-toolbar:
Lesson Runner

Run structured lessons through a sequence of nodes. Navigate forward/backward through lesson steps, watch instructional videos, mark nodes complete, and submit lesson surveys.
lesson-runner-v2:
Lesson Runner V2

Run assigned lessons through a guided sequence of nodes. Navigate forward/backward using the arrow buttons or jump to First/Last node. Watch instructional videos, track progress with visited/completed checkmarks, and click Finish when all nodes are visited to complete the lesson. Your progress is automatically saved and can be resumed later.
lesson-builder-v2:
Lesson Builder V2

Enhanced lesson builder that combines both the Selections toolbar and Lesson Runner functionality in a unified interface. The left pane shows your selected nodes list (collapsible), while the right pane displays the lesson content with instructional videos. Navigate through lessons using the buttons at the bottom, reorder selected nodes by dragging, and manage your lesson progress all in one place.
lessons-toolbar:
Lesson Selection

Create and manage lessons for decision tree nodes. Lessons can be associated with individual nodes or entire flows. Use ownership context filters to control lesson visibility across system, tenant, team, and personal levels. Promote lessons to share them with other users or teams.
favorites-toolbar:
Technique Toolbox

Your personal collection of favorite techniques. Add, remove, and navigate to techniques from your saved favorites for quick access. Click on any favorite to select and navigate to that technique in the tree. Use the remove button to delete favorites you no longer need.
node-painter-toolbar:
Node Painter

Node Painter provides tools to modify the tree structure. Add child nodes, reparent nodes, insert between nodes, promote nodes, delete nodes, edit node properties, and manage child nodes.
nodes-list-toolbar:
Node List Navigation

Browse all nodes in the current tree. Click any node to select it. The list automatically scrolls to show the currently selected node.
quick-nav-toolbar:
Quick-Nav

Quick-Nav provides a collapsible tree view for navigating your decision flow. Click nodes to select them, use the default level expansion control to set how many levels to expand automatically. Click the ▶/▼ icons to expand/collapse branches.
rotation-control-toolbar:
Navigation

Control rotation, pan, and zoom of the visualization. Use the rotation wheel to rotate the view, adjust pan with X/Y sliders, control zoom level, and reset any or all transformations.

Mouse Around

Pan, Zoom and rotate can also be controlled with the left-clicking and dragging to pan, mouse wheel to zoom and mouse+ALT to rotate.
search-toolbar:
Search

Search for nodes in the tree by ID or name. Use the ID field to search by node identifier, or the Terms field to search by node names. Click on any result to select that node in the visualization.
selected-node-state-toolbar: Displays the currently selected node ID. Shows which node is actively selected in the tree visualization.
selected-nodes-toolbar:
Selected Nodes

Selected Nodes displays the list of currently selected nodes. You can reorder nodes by dragging, remove individual nodes, clear the selection, or apply the current selection to a lesson.
skills-radar-toolbar:
Skills Radar

Visualize skill levels across multiple techniques using a radar chart. Compare your perceived skill (red), desired skill (blue), and professional/elite level (green) for selected nodes.
team-group-members-toolbar:
Team Group Members

View and manage members of the selected team group. Sort players by different criteria and toggle member selection.
team-roster-toolbar:
Team Rosters

View and manage the complete roster for the selected team. Filter and sort players, toggle selections, and manage team groups.
teams-toolbar:
Team Selection

and manage teams and team groups. Create, edit, and delete teams/groups. Configure team membership and group assignments.
technique-explorer-toolbar:
Technique Explorer

Explore node content, watch technique videos, mark nodes as completed, and add favorites/bookmarks.
tenancy-toolbar:
Tenancy Selection

View and manage organization tenancy. Select your active organization, view current user details, and switch between available organizations and roles.
view-effects-toolbar:
View/Effects

The View/Effects toolbar controls visualization display settings:

Toggles:
• Tree Visibility: Show/hide the entire tree structure
• Background Color: Toggle between light and dark backgrounds
• Auto-fade: Automatically fade non-selected elements
• Scroll-to-node: Automatically pan to selected nodes

Node Count: Displays the current number of visible nodes in the tree structure.
viewport-info-toolbar:
Viewport

Displays viewport dimensions, visual mode, zoom/pan values, rotation angle, node counts, and drawing statistics.
visualization-options-toolbar:
Visualization Options

Format & Layout: Choose between Radial (🌸), Horizontal (📊), or Vertical (🌲) tree formats. Select Tidy Tree or Cluster layout styles.

Node Count: Adjust the number of nodes (1-2000) and regenerate with new random structures using the 🎲 button.

Node Size: Choose from Extra Small (XS), Small (S), Medium (M), or Large (L) node sizes.

Text Position: Position node labels - options vary by format:
• Radial: Radiating (Leaf-only), Radiating (All), Above, Below, Left, Right
• Horizontal: Below, Radiating Horizontal
• Vertical: Horizontal and Below, Radiating Vertical

Dimensions: Adjust visualization spread using sliders showing current value and ideal dimensions. System automatically calculates optimal size based on tree structure. Max values are 200% of ideal.
• Radial: Control radius (100px - auto-calculated max)
• Horizontal/Vertical: Control width and height independently

Center Markers:
• Red Dot: Transforms with tree (pan/zoom/rotate), marks tree center
• Blue Dot: Fixed screen position, marks viewport center

Current dimensions are displayed in bottom-right corner of the visualization.
style-toolbar-tabs:
Text Styling

General Node Style Tab: Customize text appearance for all nodes. Choose font family, text size (XS, S, M, L, XL), and apply text styles (bold, italic, uppercase).

Root Node Style Tab: Override styling for the root node. Enable with the checkbox, then customize font, size, style, and color separately from other nodes. Useful for emphasizing the root element in your tree.

Color Key Tab: Configure the optional color key legend. Enable/disable the key, position it (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), customize shape (circle, square, rectangle, triangle, hexagon), and adjust colors, borders, and fonts for the key title and legend items.
drawer-to-do:
To-Do List Help

  • Add Entry: Click the ➕ Add button to create a new to-do entry
  • Edit Entry: Click any entry to edit its details
  • Manage Entries: Pin, expand descriptions, or collapse to organize your list
  • Filter Entries: Use the Target Type and Status dropdowns to filter your to-dos
  • Export: Click 📥 Export JSON to download your to-do list as a timestamped JSON file
  • Import: Click 📤 Import JSON to load a previously exported to-do list (duplicates are automatically skipped)
  • Hierarchical: Create parent-child relationships between to-dos for better organization
  • Auto-Save: All changes are automatically saved to your browser storage
